name: Sablex Cinder Duke
loreTies: Power belongs to those capable of wielding it.
Dominion Flame: decisive aggression turns enemy weakness into momentum.
Sablex Cinder Duke is a colossal Infernal Dominion deity shaped by power belongs to those capable of wielding it. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Sablex Cinder Duke is a Infernal Dominion Guardian whose Gate scar links The Infernal Dominion to Storm-Oath Covenant; their power expresses power belongs to those capable of wielding it under campaign pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Sablex Cinder Duke began as more than a weapon in The Infernal Dominion. Sablex Cinder Duke was bound to a cinder-court contract dais during a Gate disturbance that tested whether power belongs to those capable of wielding it could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Deity chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Infernal Dominion, Sablex Cinder Duke is treated as proof that a powerful civilization of ambition, conquest, hierarchy, survival, infernal law, dark artisanship, and royal violence can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries obsidian, hellfire, dark iron, chains, burning sigils, horn-lineage anatomy, ash-fire skin, volcanic cracks, but their real identity is tactical: aggression, debuffs, pulls, execution, burn pressure, power through risk. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Sablex Cinder Duke; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Deity to overextend, break battle pattern, or turn culture into raw fuel. Sablex Cinder Duke survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever risk-pressure execution appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Storm-Oath Covenant, Sablex Cinder Duke gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-deity active deity, Sablex Cinder Duke turns Dominion Flame from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Sablex Cinder Duke's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 30, attack 9, range 3, speed 2, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
